title_zh: 把婴儿探视改为视频通话

scenario.label_zh: 把婴儿探视改为视频通话
scenario.goal_zh: 说明访客担心咳嗽带来的感染风险，并约定改用视频探视

context_zh: 虚构病房探视沟通。访客向接待员说明自己的顾虑，选择不进入病房；不提供诊断或个人治疗建议。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: I've come to visit my sister and her infant, but I've developed a cough.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me before going into the ward.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: I brought a mask, but I'm still worried I could infect the baby. Can I speak to my sister another way?

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: We can help her set up a video call if she'd like one. Shall I ask her?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Please do. I'll wait outside rather than go in.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I've just spoken to her. She'd like to call you on your phone in ten minutes.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: That works. We'll have our visit by video today.
